SELECT
    rc.loan_id,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY rc.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown
WHERE status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'

SELECT
    payment_id,
    business_date,
    amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC;

SELECT
    pp.party_id,
    pp.annual_income
FROM
    person_profile pp
WHERE
    pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY
    pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT
    card_id,
    issued_on,
    expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    op.operating_status
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN
    organization_unit ou_shanghai ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou_shanghai.org_unit_id
JOIN
    organization_unit ou_branch ON ou_branch.unit_name = '上海分行'
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND ou_shanghai.region_code = ou_branch.region_code
ORDER BY
    p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    t1.org_unit_id,
    t1.unit_name,
    COUNT(t2.account_id) AS account_count
FROM organization_unit t1
LEFT JOIN account t2
    ON t1.org_unit_id = t2.org_unit_id
GROUP BY
    t1.org_unit_id,
    t1.unit_name
ORDER BY
    account_count DESC;

SELECT
    t1.sector_name_zh,
    SUM(t2.contract_amount) AS contract_amount_sum
FROM industry_sector t1
JOIN credit_agreement t2 ON t1.sector_code = t2.target_industry_code
JOIN party t3 ON t2.borrower_party_id = t3.party_id
WHERE t3.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY t1.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY contract_amount_sum DESC

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_fair_value
FROM
    wealth_product wp
JOIN
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE
    phs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name
ORDER BY
    total_fair_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(abs(abs(abs_balance.ledger_balance))), 2) AS deposit_balance_sum
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs_balance ON a.account_id = abs_balance.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND abs_balance.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    deposit_balance_sum DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS avg_principal_overdue_days
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name
HAVING avg_principal_overdue_days > 90
ORDER BY avg_principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS exposure_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON egm.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ah.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON eg.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    cs.net_capital
ORDER BY
    exposure_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    t1.sector_name_zh,
    COUNT(t3.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t4.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonperforming_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t4.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(t3.loan_id), 6) AS nonperforming_ratio
FROM industry_sector t1
JOIN credit_agreement t2 ON t1.sector_code = t2.target_industry_code
JOIN loan_drawdown t3 ON t2.agreement_id = t3.agreement_id
JOIN risk_classification t4 ON t3.loan_id = t4.loan_id
WHERE t4.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY t1.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(t3.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY nonperforming_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    borrower_party_id,
    display_name,
    SUM(contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement
JOIN party ON borrower_party_id = party.party_id
GROUP BY borrower_party_id, display_name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT
    risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    ROUND(AVG(management_fee_rate), 2) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level ASC;

SELECT
    t1.guarantor_party_id,
    t2.display_name,
    SUM(t1.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM
    guarantor_commitment t1
JOIN
    party t2 ON t1.guarantor_party_id = t2.party_id
WHERE
    t1.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    t1.guarantor_party_id,
    t2.display_name
HAVING
    SUM(t1.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM
    party_relation pr
JOIN
    party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(d.record_id) AS record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(d.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 d
JOIN institution i ON d.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE d.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(r.record_id) AS overdue_record_count
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    (r.deadline_date IS NOT NULL AND r.completion_date IS NULL)
    OR (r.deadline_date IS NOT NULL AND r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    COUNT(r.record_id) >= 20
ORDER BY
    overdue_record_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT
    r.loan_id,
    d.principal_overdue_days,
    g.grade_name_zh,
    r.as_of_date
FROM risk_classification r
JOIN delinquency_snapshot d
    ON r.loan_id = d.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade g
    ON r.grade_code = g.grade_code
WHERE d.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND r.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND d.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND g.grade_name_zh IN ('正常', '关注')
ORDER BY d.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    provision_snapshot ps ON lbs.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
WHERE
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) > 100000000
ORDER BY
    insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name,
    ind.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
  AND pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS violation_amount,
    SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS total_instruction_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 6) AS violation_ratio
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution inst ON ca.institution_id = inst.institution_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
GROUP BY inst.institution_name
ORDER BY violation_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    h.asset_id,
    a.maturity_on,
    p.actual_termination_on
FROM wealth_product p
JOIN product_holding_snapshot h ON p.product_id = h.product_id
JOIN managed_asset a ON h.asset_id = a.asset_id
WHERE a.maturity_on > p.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY a.maturity_on DESC;

WITH GuarantorAgreements AS (
    -- 找出所有作为担保人的记录
    -- 通过 guarantor_commitment 找到担保人 party_id 和关联的担保合同 security_id
    -- 通过 secured_obligation 找到担保合同关联的授信协议 agreement_id
    SELECT DISTINCT
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        gc.security_id,
        so.agreement_id
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN secured_obligation so ON gc.security_id = so.security_id
    WHERE so.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
),
GuarantorCounts AS (
    -- 统计每个主体作为担保人的协议笔数（去重后的 agreement_id）
    SELECT
        ga.guarantor_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ga.agreement_id) AS guarantee_count
    FROM GuarantorAgreements ga
    GROUP BY ga.guarantor_party_id
),
BorrowerAgreements AS (
    -- 找出所有作为借款人的记录
    -- 通过 credit_agreement 找到借款人 borrower_party_id 和协议 agreement_id
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
),
BorrowerCounts AS (
    -- 统计每个主体作为借款人的协议笔数
    SELECT
        ba.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ba.agreement_id) AS borrower_count
    FROM BorrowerAgreements ba
    GROUP BY ba.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COALESCE(gc.guarantee_count, 0) AS guarantee_count,
    COALESCE(bc.borrower_count, 0) AS borrower_count
FROM GuarantorCounts gc
JOIN BorrowerCounts bc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = bc.borrower_party_id
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT
    t1.payment_id,
    t1.business_date,
    t3.name_zh,
    t1.amount,
    t4.unit_name
FROM payment_event t1
JOIN payment_type_catalog t3 ON t1.payment_type = t3.payment_type
JOIN organization_unit t4 ON t1.origin_org_unit_id = t4.org_unit_id
WHERE
    t1.is_cash = 1
    AND t1.amount > 5000000
    AND t1.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY
    t1.amount DESC

SELECT
    t1.agreement_id,
    t2.display_name,
    t3.sector_name_zh,
    t4.sector_name_zh,
    t1.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement t1
JOIN party t2 ON t1.borrower_party_id = t2.party_id
JOIN organization_profile t3 ON t2.party_id = t3.party_id
JOIN industry_sector t4 ON t1.target_industry_code = t4.sector_code
WHERE t3.industry_code != t1.target_industry_code
ORDER BY t1.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    pa_party.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    ra_party.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account pa ON pe.from_account_id = pa.account_id
JOIN account ra ON pe.to_account_id = ra.account_id
JOIN account_holder pa_holder ON pa.account_id = pa_holder.account_id AND pa_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder ra_holder ON ra.account_id = ra_holder.account_id AND ra_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party pa_party ON pa_holder.party_id = pa_party.party_id
JOIN party ra_party ON ra_holder.party_id = ra_party.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = pa_party.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ra_party.party_id
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC

SELECT
    t1.agreement_id,
    t2.display_name,
    COUNT(t1.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown t1
JOIN credit_agreement t3 ON t1.agreement_id = t3.agreement_id
JOIN party t2 ON t3.borrower_party_id = t2.party_id
GROUP BY t1.agreement_id, t2.display_name
HAVING COUNT(t1.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cnt,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING cnt >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    so.staff_id,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cnt
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN account ac_to ON pe.to_account_id = ac_to.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ac_to.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN organization_profile op ON ah.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY so.staff_id
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    t1.record_id,
    t2.institution_name,
    t1.event_date,
    t1.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(t1.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 t1
JOIN institution t2
    ON t1.institution_id = t2.institution_id
WHERE t1.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY days_diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    cl.security_id,
    cl.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ca.status = 'RELEASED'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY cl.security_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_name,
        l.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, l.loan_id ASC
        ) AS balance_rank
    FROM loan_drawdown l
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    balance_rank
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE balance_rank = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_balance_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ind.sector_name_zh,
        lds.loan_id,
        lds.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ind.sector_name_zh ORDER BY lds.principal_balance DESC) as rnk
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lds
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
    WHERE lds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    sector_name_zh,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rnk
FROM loan_balance_ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY sector_name_zh ASC, rnk ASC;

WITH daily_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
)
SELECT 
    business_date,
    daily_count,
    daily_count - LAG(daily_count) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM daily_counts
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

WITH institution_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ia.avg_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - ia.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN institution_avg ia ON ca.institution_id = ia.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > ia.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM security_agreement sa
INNER JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
INNER JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE cl.collateral_id IS NULL
GROUP BY
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '未逾期'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
        ELSE '360天以上'
    END AS overdue_interval,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot
WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 2
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 3
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 2
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 3
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END ASC;

SELECT
    collateral_id,
    valued_on,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
    collateral_valuation
GROUP BY
    collateral_id,
    valued_on
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY
    collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_principal_balance
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
ORDER BY
    avg_principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS avg_annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 6) AS high_income_ratio
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH account_org AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.payment_id,
        pe.amount,
        pe.from_account_id,
        pe.to_account_id,
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT au.institution_id FROM account au WHERE au.account_id = pe.from_account_id),
            (SELECT au.institution_id FROM account au WHERE au.account_id = pe.to_account_id)
        ) AS institution_id
    FROM payment_event pe
),
party_roles AS (
    SELECT 
        ao.payment_id,
        ao.amount,
        ao.institution_id,
        (SELECT ah.party_id FROM account_holder ah 
         WHERE ah.account_id = ao.from_account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY' 
         LIMIT 1) AS payer_party_id,
        (SELECT ah.party_id FROM account_holder ah 
         WHERE ah.account_id = ao.to_account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY' 
         LIMIT 1) AS payee_party_id
    FROM account_org ao
),
relation_check AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.payment_id,
        pr.amount,
        pr.institution_id,
        pr.payer_party_id,
        pr.payee_party_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM party_relation pr_rel 
                WHERE pr_rel.source_party_id = pr.payer_party_id 
                  AND pr_rel.target_party_id = pr.payee_party_id 
                  AND pr_rel.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_related
    FROM party_roles pr
),
agg AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_related = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS related_amount,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM relation_check
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(a.related_amount, 2) AS related_amount,
    ROUND(a.total_amount, 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(a.related_amount * 1.0 / a.total_amount, 6) AS ratio
FROM agg a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE a.total_amount > 0
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_count
FROM party p
INNER JOIN payment_card pc
    ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id
INNER JOIN card_type_catalog ctc
    ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
INNER JOIN term_deposit td
    ON p.party_id = (
        SELECT ah.party_id
        FROM account_holder ah
        INNER JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
        WHERE a.account_id = td.account_id
        AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    )
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)), 2) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    avg_loan_age_days DESC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        l.loan_id,
        l.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY l.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot l
    WHERE l.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM RankedLoans
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        l.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown l
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND l.status = 'ACTIVE'
),
industry_balance AS (
    SELECT
        op.industry_code,
        SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_balance lb
    JOIN organization_profile op ON lb.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    WHERE op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY op.industry_code
),
industry_rank AS (
    SELECT
        ind.sector_name_zh,
        ib.total_balance,
        SUM(ib.total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY ib.total_balance DESC) AS cumulative_balance,
        SUM(ib.total_balance) OVER () AS grand_total_balance
    FROM industry_balance ib
    JOIN industry_sector ind ON ib.industry_code = ind.sector_code
)
SELECT
    sector_name_zh,
    ROUND(total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(cumulative_balance * 1.0 / grand_total_balance, 6) AS cumulative_ratio
FROM industry_rank
WHERE cumulative_balance * 1.0 / grand_total_balance <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.valuation_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valued_on = (
    SELECT MAX(cv2.valued_on)
    FROM collateral_valuation cv2
    WHERE cv2.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
)
AND cv.valuation_amount > 2.0 * sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN
    account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 2
ORDER BY
    institution_count DESC;

SELECT
    from_account_id,
    business_date,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM
    payment_event
GROUP BY
    from_account_id,
    business_date
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal_balance DESC;

SELECT
    g.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.security_id) AS contract_count,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING total_guaranteed_amount > 300000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ls.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_balance_snapshot ls
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ls.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ls.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ls.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ls.overdue_since)) >= 90
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    pi.instruction_amount,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE
    ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY
    pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    t1.agreement_id,
    t2.display_name,
    t1.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement AS t1
JOIN party AS t2
    ON t1.borrower_party_id = t2.party_id
WHERE t2.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND t2.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND t1.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t1.contract_amount DESC

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    lpc.product_name_zh,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
JOIN industry_sector isec ON ca.target_industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE
    lpc.is_working_capital = 1
    AND isec.risk_category = 'EXIT'
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH institution_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ia.avg_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - ia.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN institution_avg ia ON ca.institution_id = ia.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 2.0 * ia.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

WITH institution_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
non_related_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.target_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    )
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0) AS non_related_amount,
    it.total_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0) * 1.0 / it.total_amount, 6) AS ratio
FROM institution_totals it
JOIN institution i ON it.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN non_related_amounts nra ON it.institution_id = nra.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_loan_balance,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN institution inst ON ca.institution_id = inst.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON ca.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.net_capital > 0
GROUP BY
    inst.institution_name,
    p.display_name,
    cs.net_capital
HAVING
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) > 0.1
ORDER BY
    concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        target_industry_code,
        ROUND(AVG(annual_interest_rate), 4) as avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
)
SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    ca.annual_interest_rate,
    iav.avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - iav.avg_rate) * 100.0 / iav.avg_rate, 2) as spread_pct
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN industry_avg_rate iav ON ca.target_industry_code = iav.target_industry_code
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND iav.avg_rate > 0
  AND (ca.annual_interest_rate - iav.avg_rate) * 100.0 / iav.avg_rate > 10
ORDER BY spread_pct DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS over_limit_customer_count
FROM
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN
    capital_snapshot cs ON ca.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.net_capital > 0
    AND ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) > 0.1
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    over_limit_customer_count DESC;

WITH group_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_exposure
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
group_concentration AS (
    SELECT
        ge.exposure_group_id,
        ge.group_name,
        ge.total_exposure,
        gc.net_capital,
        ROUND(ge.total_exposure * 1.0 / gc.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
    FROM group_exposure ge
    JOIN group_capital gc ON ge.institution_id = gc.institution_id
)
SELECT
    exposure_group_id,
    group_name,
    total_exposure,
    net_capital,
    concentration_ratio
FROM group_concentration
WHERE concentration_ratio > 0.1
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.loan_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_interval
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe
    ON ld.disbursement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
    AND pe.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
    AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
WHERE
    julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) >= 0
    AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) <= 7
ORDER BY
    days_interval ASC,
    pe.amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH institution_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
ranked_borrowers AS (
    SELECT 
        be.institution_id,
        be.borrower_party_id,
        be.total_principal_balance,
        ic.net_capital,
        ROUND(be.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY be.institution_id ORDER BY be.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital DESC) as rn
    FROM borrower_exposure be
    JOIN institution_capital ic ON be.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    WHERE ic.net_capital > 0
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    rb.exposure_ratio
FROM ranked_borrowers rb
JOIN institution i ON rb.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON rb.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rb.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY l.agreement_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS grade_rank
    FROM loan_drawdown l
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    grade_rank
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY grade_rank ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown l
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND lbs.principal_balance IS NOT NULL
),
institution_totals AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        SUM(principal_balance) AS total_institution_balance
    FROM loan_balance
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.institution_name,
        lb.principal_balance,
        ROUND(lb.principal_balance * 1.0 / it.total_institution_balance * 100, 2) AS proportion_percentage,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lb.institution_id
            ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC, lb.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance lb
    JOIN institution_totals it ON lb.institution_id = it.institution_id
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    institution_name,
    principal_balance,
    proportion_percentage
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY institution_name ASC, proportion_percentage DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    COALESCE(dbs.overdue_principal, 0) AS overdue_principal,
    COALESCE(rs.overdue_count, 0) AS overdue_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        SUM(overdue_principal) AS overdue_principal
    FROM delinquency_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY loan_id
) dbs ON ld.loan_id = dbs.loan_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
    FROM repayment_schedule
    WHERE status = 'OVERDUE'
    GROUP BY loan_id
) rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND COALESCE(rs.overdue_count, 0) >= 2
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC, overdue_principal DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on,
    COUNT(loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM
    loan_drawdown
GROUP BY
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on
HAVING
    COUNT(loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    t1.party_id
FROM
    account_holder t1
    INNER JOIN account t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
    INNER JOIN term_deposit t3 ON t2.account_id = t3.account_id
    INNER JOIN credit_agreement t4 ON t1.party_id = t4.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY
    t1.party_id
ORDER BY
    t1.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id
FROM
    party p
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'STAFF'
    AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND p.party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT
            ah.party_id
        FROM
            account_holder ah
    )
ORDER BY
    p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (
      SELECT pe.from_account_id
      FROM payment_event pe
      JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
      WHERE ptc.name_zh = '现金支取'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    security_id,
    guaranteed_amount
FROM
    guarantor_commitment
WHERE
    status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY
    guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) < 0 THEN '已到期'
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) <= 90 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '常态'
    END AS maturity_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
WHERE ld.status != 'WRITTEN_OFF'
GROUP BY maturity_bucket
ORDER BY
    CASE maturity_bucket
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2
        WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS link_count
FROM
    collateral_link cl
JOIN
    security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE
    cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    cl.collateral_id
HAVING
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) > 1
ORDER BY
    link_count DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_type,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) AS valuation_count
FROM collateral_valuation cv
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation_amount DESC;

WITH AccountLoanStats AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id) AS loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        repayment_account_id,
        loan_id,
        disbursed_on,
        disbursed_amount,
        loan_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repayment_account_id ORDER BY disbursed_on ASC) AS rn
    FROM AccountLoanStats
    WHERE loan_count >= 3
)
SELECT 
    repayment_account_id,
    loan_id,
    disbursed_on,
    disbursed_amount
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY repayment_account_id ASC, disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount
HAVING
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance), 2) AS total_difference
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE abs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
  AND (abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_difference DESC;

SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.opening_principal,
    t.maturity_on,
    t.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT
    pc.card_id,
    ctc.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    pc.issued_on
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE pc.issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND pc.card_type = 'DEBIT'
  AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY pc.issued_on ASC, pc.card_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS entrusted_payment_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS self_payment_amount,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount),
        6
    ) AS entrusted_payment_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > 0
   AND ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount),
        6
    ) < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_payment_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

WITH contract_total AS (
    SELECT
        agreement_id,
        SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
)
SELECT
    ld.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额,
    ct.total_disbursed AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / ct.total_disbursed, 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN contract_total ct ON ld.agreement_id = ct.agreement_id
WHERE ct.total_disbursed > 0
  AND ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / ct.total_disbursed > 90
ORDER BY ld.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS planned_raise_amount,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) AS actual_raise_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 6) AS completion_rate
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution inst ON wp.issuer_institution_id = inst.institution_id
GROUP BY inst.institution_name
HAVING completion_rate > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

WITH overdue_loans AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.agreement_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    INNER JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
    WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
    GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.agreement_id
),
borrower_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ol.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    INNER JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN overdue_loans ol ON ld.loan_id = ol.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
    HAVING overdue_loan_count > 0 AND total_loan_count > overdue_loan_count
)
SELECT
    bs.borrower_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    bs.overdue_loan_count,
    bs.total_loan_count
FROM borrower_stats bs
INNER JOIN party p ON bs.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY bs.overdue_loan_count DESC, bs.borrower_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
LEFT JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE
    pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
    AND pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id <> ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY
    pi.instruction_amount DESC,
    pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    t1.loan_id,
    COUNT(t1.installment_id) AS unpaid_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(t1.principal_due), 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM repayment_schedule t1
WHERE t1.status != 'PAID'
GROUP BY t1.loan_id
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 END) = 0
ORDER BY total_principal_due DESC, t1.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    t1.loan_id,
    ROUND(t1.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(t1.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_balance_snapshot t1
JOIN loan_drawdown t2
    ON t1.loan_id = t2.loan_id
WHERE
    t2.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
    AND t1.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY
    t1.principal_balance DESC,
    t1.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    t1.agreement_id,
    t1.security_type,
    t1.contract_amount,
    t2.display_name
FROM credit_agreement t1
JOIN party t2
    ON t1.borrower_party_id = t2.party_id
WHERE t1.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND t1.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY t1.contract_amount DESC, t1.agreement_id ASC

WITH institution_product_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        ROUND(AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate), 4) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
),
related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pr.target_party_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
)
SELECT
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS borrower_id,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS contract_rate,
    ipa.avg_rate AS avg_contract_rate,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate - ipa.avg_rate, 4) AS rate_spread
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN institution_product_avg ipa
    ON ca.institution_id = ipa.institution_id
    AND ca.product_family = ipa.product_family
JOIN party p
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN related_borrowers rb
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = rb.target_party_id
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate < ipa.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh
FROM
    party_relation pr
JOIN
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE
    rtc.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loan_drawdown ld1
        WHERE ld1.agreement_id IN (
            SELECT ca.agreement_id
            FROM credit_agreement ca
            WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
        )
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loan_drawdown ld2
        WHERE ld2.agreement_id IN (
            SELECT ca.agreement_id
            FROM credit_agreement ca
            WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
        )
    )
ORDER BY
    rtc.relation_name_zh ASC,
    pr.relation_id ASC;

WITH group_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id
    HAVING member_count >= 2
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON eg.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.group_name,
        glb.member_count,
        glb.total_loan_balance,
        gc.net_capital,
        ROUND(glb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / gc.net_capital, 6) AS ratio
    FROM group_loan_balance glb
    JOIN exposure_group eg ON glb.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN group_capital gc ON glb.exposure_group_id = gc.exposure_group_id
    WHERE gc.net_capital > 0
)
SELECT 
    group_name,
    member_count,
    ROUND(total_loan_balance, 2) AS total_loan_balance,
    ROUND(net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ratio
FROM combined
WHERE ratio > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    payer.display_name AS payer_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transfer_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_transfer_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder from_holder ON from_acc.account_id = from_holder.account_id AND from_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder to_holder ON to_acc.account_id = to_holder.account_id AND to_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party payer ON from_holder.party_id = payer.party_id
JOIN party payee ON to_holder.party_id = payee.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON (pr.source_party_id = from_holder.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = to_holder.party_id)
    OR (pr.source_party_id = to_holder.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = from_holder.party_id)
WHERE pe.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY
    payer.display_name,
    payee.display_name
ORDER BY
    total_transfer_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    t1.product_id,
    COUNT(t1.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot t1
WHERE t1.lookthrough_depth > 1
GROUP BY t1.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    lds.loan_id,
    lds.principal_balance,
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lds
INNER JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON lds.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE lds.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND lds.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    lds.loan_id,
    lds.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY
    max_overdue_days DESC,
    lds.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON egm.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM exposure_group_member fm
JOIN exposure_group eg ON fm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = fm.party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name
ORDER BY
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

WITH borrower_loans AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_guarantees AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.guarantor_party_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    gg.total_guarantee_amount AS 对外担保合计,
    bl.total_loan_amount AS 自身借款合计,
    ROUND(gg.total_guarantee_amount - bl.total_loan_amount, 2) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
INNER JOIN borrower_loans bl ON p.party_id = bl.borrower_party_id
INNER JOIN guarantor_guarantees gg ON p.party_id = gg.guarantor_party_id
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name,
    sm.staff_id,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON sm.person_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    p.display_name,
    sm.staff_id
ORDER BY
    agreement_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name,
    p.party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS principal_balance_sum,
    pp.annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS balance_income_ratio
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id
        FROM credit_agreement ca
        WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    )
JOIN
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    pp.annual_income
HAVING
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) > 2
ORDER BY
    balance_income_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    p.display_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS self_loan_agreement_count
FROM
    service_operator so
    INNER JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
    INNER JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
    INNER JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE
    so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_HANDLER'
    AND p.party_type = 'STAFF'
GROUP BY
    p.display_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level
ORDER BY
    self_loan_agreement_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.disbursed_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account acc ON ld.loan_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
  AND p.party_type = 'STAFF'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name,
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_repayment_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS repayment_to_income_ratio
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    pp.annual_income
ORDER BY
    repayment_to_income_ratio DESC,
    p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50

SELECT
    lpc.product_name_zh,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS overdue_principal_sum
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY overdue_principal_sum DESC;

WITH term_deposit_stats AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 END) AS expired_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on <= DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 END) AS within_90_days_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 END) AS beyond_90_days_count
    FROM account a
    JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 END) >= 20
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    tds.expired_count,
    tds.within_90_days_count,
    tds.beyond_90_days_count
FROM term_deposit_stats tds
JOIN institution i ON tds.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY tds.expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM
    account_holder ah
JOIN
    organization_unit ou ON ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY' AND ou.org_unit_id = (
        SELECT p.home_org_unit_id
        FROM party p
        WHERE p.party_id = ah.party_id
    )
WHERE
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM account_holder ah2
        WHERE ah2.account_id = ah.account_id
    ) > 1
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(lbs.loan_id) AS overdue_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING total_overdue_principal > 120000000
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 END) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN rs.interest_due ELSE 0 END), 2) AS overdue_interest_sum
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name
HAVING overdue_installment_count >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id,
    rs.installment_no,
    rs.principal_due,
    rs.interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND rs.principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY rs.principal_due DESC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM institution inst
JOIN credit_facility cf ON inst.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON inst.institution_id = (SELECT ca.institution_id FROM credit_agreement ca WHERE ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id)
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON inst.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    inst.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital
HAVING
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY
    disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
    ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE
    sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
HAVING
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    t1.facility_id,
    t1.limit_amount,
    t2.name_zh
FROM credit_facility AS t1
INNER JOIN status_catalog AS t2
    ON t1.status = t2.status_code
    AND t2.entity = 'credit_agreement'
ORDER BY t1.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_limit_amount
FROM
    credit_facility cf
JOIN
    institution i ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type
HAVING
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY
    total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    t1.facility_type,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
    credit_facility t1
WHERE
    t1.limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY
    t1.facility_type
ORDER BY
    record_count DESC;

SELECT
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS record_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON ld.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
GROUP BY
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY
    record_count DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        actual_raise_amount,
        minimum_holding_days,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS group_id
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
),
group_counts AS (
    SELECT
        group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY group_id
)
SELECT
    group_id,
    product_count
FROM group_counts
WHERE product_count BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY group_id ASC;

SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS limit_amount_sum,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
  AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
GROUP BY cf.facility_id
ORDER BY limit_amount_sum DESC;

SELECT
    t1.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(t2.instruction_id) AS instruction_count
FROM payment_mode_catalog t1
JOIN payment_instruction t2
    ON t1.payment_mode = t2.payment_mode
WHERE t2.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY t1.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY instruction_count DESC;

SELECT
    it.name_zh AS instrument_name,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM
    instrument_type_catalog it
CROSS JOIN
    status_catalog sc
WHERE
    sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY
    it.name_zh,
    sc.name_zh;

SELECT
    t1.org_unit_id,
    t1.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t2.staff_id) AS cnt
FROM organization_unit t1
INNER JOIN staff_assignment t2
    ON t1.org_unit_id = t2.org_unit_id
WHERE t2.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
GROUP BY
    t1.org_unit_id,
    t1.unit_name
ORDER BY
    cnt DESC;

SELECT
    ls.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ls.principal_overdue_days,
    ls.overdue_principal
FROM delinquency_snapshot ls
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ls.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ls.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY ls.principal_overdue_days DESC, ls.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(psn.loan_id) AS cnt
FROM provision_snapshot psn
JOIN institution i ON psn.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    psn.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND psn.provision_stage = '2'
    AND psn.recognized_amount < 0.5 * psn.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    cnt DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_total
FROM
    provision_snapshot p
JOIN
    loan_drawdown l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    provision_gap_total DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    b.ledger_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot b
    ON a.account_id = b.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder h
    ON a.account_id = h.account_id
    AND h.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND a.status = 'DORMANT'
    AND h.account_holder_id IS NULL
    AND b.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY b.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM
    person_profile pp
JOIN
    party p ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE
    pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    ma.asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM
    managed_asset ma
JOIN
    industry_sector isec ON ma.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE
    isec.risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
GROUP BY
    ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING
    COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY
    asset_count DESC,
    ma.asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS debt_service_ratio
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN
    credit_facility cf ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income
HAVING
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY
    debt_service_ratio DESC,
    p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector,
    COUNT(p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC,
    pp.occupation_code ASC,
    pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT
    pc.status AS card_status,
    COUNT(pc.card_id) AS card_count
FROM
    payment_card pc
JOIN
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE
    ctc.name_zh = '借记卡'
GROUP BY
    pc.status
ORDER BY
    card_count DESC,
    pc.status ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN party p ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    total_amount DESC,
    ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 现金交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN payment_event pe ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY 现金交易笔数 DESC, 金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    holder_party_id,
    COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    ct.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(pe.payment_id), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc ON pe.from_account_id = acc.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON acc.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ct ON pc.card_type = ct.card_type
WHERE ct.name_zh IN ('贷记卡', '借记卡')
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY
    ct.name_zh
ORDER BY
    avg_amount DESC,
    ct.name_zh ASC;

SELECT
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE status = 'SETTLED'
  AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY channel
HAVING avg_amount > 11780000
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, channel ASC;

SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM term_deposit t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND t.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    t.collateral_id,
    t.asset_label,
    t.max_valuation_amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        cv.collateral_id,
        ca.asset_label,
        MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_valuation_amount,
        COUNT(cv.valuation_id) AS eval_count
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
    JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
    GROUP BY cv.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
    HAVING COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
) t
ORDER BY t.max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS link_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING link_count >= 2
ORDER BY link_count DESC, cl.collateral_id ASC;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
),
guarantor_details AS (
    SELECT
        gc.commitment_id,
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        gc.guaranteed_amount,
        gc.security_id,
        gc.status AS commitment_status
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
)
SELECT
    gd.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    so.agreement_id,
    ROUND(gd.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(loan_totals.total_disbursed_amount, 2) AS total_disbursed_amount
FROM guarantor_details gd
JOIN secured_obligation so ON gd.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN loan_totals ON so.agreement_id = loan_totals.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON gd.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gd.guaranteed_amount > loan_totals.total_disbursed_amount
ORDER BY gd.guaranteed_amount DESC, gd.guarantor_party_id ASC, so.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0) AS total_covered_amount,
    ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0) AS coverage_gap
FROM credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN secured_obligation so
    ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
    AND so.effective_from <= '2026-06-30'
    AND (so.effective_to IS NULL OR so.effective_to > '2026-06-30')
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 0
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING ca.contract_amount > COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0)
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(ps.loan_id) AS cnt
FROM
    risk_classification rc
JOIN
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE
    cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
    AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY
    cnt DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ca.borrower_party_id AS debtor_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS loan_balance,
    ca.contract_amount AS credit_amount,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS balance_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 0
  AND lbs.principal_balance >= ca.contract_amount * 4
ORDER BY balance_ratio DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS over_provision_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount), 2) AS over_provision_amount
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE
    rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY
    over_provision_amount DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC,
    cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

WITH internal_max AS (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_internal_valuation
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
),
external_max AS (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_external_valuation
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(im.max_internal_valuation, 2) AS max_internal_valuation,
    ROUND(em.max_external_valuation, 2) AS max_external_valuation,
    ROUND(im.max_internal_valuation - em.max_external_valuation, 2) AS valuation_difference
FROM collateral_asset ca
INNER JOIN internal_max im ON ca.collateral_id = im.collateral_id
INNER JOIN external_max em ON ca.collateral_id = em.collateral_id
