WHERE im.max_internal_valuation > em.max_external_valuation
ORDER BY valuation_difference DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    cv.valuation_amount,
    cl.total_pledged_amount,
    ROUND(cl.total_pledged_amount - cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valued_on) AS latest_valued_on
    FROM collateral_valuation
    GROUP BY collateral_id
) latest_cv ON ca.collateral_id = latest_cv.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_valuation cv
    ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
    AND latest_cv.latest_valued_on = cv.valued_on
JOIN (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        SUM(pledged_amount) AS total_pledged_amount
    FROM collateral_link
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
) cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE cl.total_pledged_amount > cv.valuation_amount
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC;

WITH borrower_loans AS (
    -- 计算每个借款人（在本行有授信借款）的自身借款合同金额合计
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_borrowed_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_commitments AS (
    -- 计算每个保证人（对外提供担保）的对外有效保证承诺金额合计
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(bl.total_borrowed_amount, 2) AS total_borrowed_amount,
    ROUND(gc.total_guaranteed_amount, 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM party p
INNER JOIN borrower_loans bl ON p.party_id = bl.borrower_party_id
INNER JOIN guarantor_commitments gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.total_guaranteed_amount > bl.total_borrowed_amount
ORDER BY gc.total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM
    security_agreement sa
JOIN
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
HAVING
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM
    party p
    INNER JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.is_public_official = 1
    AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    eg.group_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name,
    eg.group_type
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY
    member_count DESC;

SELECT
    t.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    t.group_count

        party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT exposure_group_id) AS group_count

    GROUP BY party_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT exposure_group_id) >= 2
) t
JOIN party p ON t.party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY t.group_count DESC, t.party_id ASC;

SELECT

    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS relation_count,

FROM party p
INNER JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
INNER JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY relation_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
INNER JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
INNER JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
INNER JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'

    p.party_id,
    p.display_name

SELECT
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COALESCE(s.loan_count, 0) AS source_loan_count,
    COALESCE(t.loan_count, 0) AS target_loan_count
FROM party_relation pr
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    INNER JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) s ON pr.source_party_id = s.borrower_party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    INNER JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) t ON pr.target_party_id = t.borrower_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.loan_count, 0) + COALESCE(t.loan_count, 0)) DESC;

SELECT
    t1.collateral_id,
    t1.asset_label,
    t1.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset t1
WHERE t1.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM collateral_link t2
      WHERE t2.collateral_id = t1.collateral_id
        AND t2.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY t1.collateral_id ASC;

WITH guarantor_liability AS (
    -- 1. 计算每个担保人的有效保证承诺金额合计
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    -- 2. 计算每个借款人（作为借款人）的当前本金余额合计
    -- 使用 loan_balance_snapshot 表，取审计基准日 '2026-06-30' 的快照
    -- 通过 loan_drawdown 关联 credit_agreement 获取 borrower_party_id
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ldd
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ldd.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ldd.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
borrower_total_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        borrower_party_id,
        SUM(principal_balance) AS total_loan_exposure
    FROM borrower_exposure
    GROUP BY borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(gl.total_guaranteed_amount, 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(bte.total_loan_exposure, 0), 2) AS own_loan_exposure,
    ROUND(gl.total_guaranteed_amount - COALESCE(bte.total_loan_exposure, 0), 2) AS excess_guarantee_amount
FROM guarantor_liability gl
JOIN party p ON gl.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN borrower_total_exposure bte ON gl.guarantor_party_id = bte.borrower_party_id
WHERE gl.total_guaranteed_amount > COALESCE(bte.total_loan_exposure, 0)
ORDER BY excess_guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    gc.guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status
FROM
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loan_drawdown ld
        JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
        JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
        WHERE
            ca.borrower_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
            AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
            AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    )
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC,
    gc.guarantor_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE
    wp.issuer_institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
    AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY
    wp.product_name ASC,
    overdue_principal_total DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_type,
    COUNT(sa.security_id) AS contract_count,
    ROUND(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 2) AS total_secured_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
INNER JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
INNER JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY total_secured_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2),
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,

FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id

JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(h.carrying_amount - h.fair_value), 2) AS inverted_amount_sum,
    COUNT(h.holding_id) AS inverted_holding_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot h
JOIN wealth_product p ON h.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE h.carrying_amount > h.fair_value
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING SUM(h.carrying_amount - h.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY inverted_amount_sum DESC, p.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    COALESCE(loan_overdue.total_overdue_principal, 0) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp
    ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma
    ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN institution inst
    ON wp.issuer_institution_id = inst.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.borrower_party_id
    AND ld.institution_id = inst.institution_id
    AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds
    ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
    AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ds.overdue_principal > 0
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ld2.borrower_party_id,
        inst2.institution_id,
        SUM(ds2.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds2
        ON ld2.loan_id = ds2.loan_id
        AND ds2.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
        AND ds2.overdue_principal > 0
    JOIN institution inst2
        ON ld2.institution_id = inst2.institution_id
    GROUP BY
        ld2.borrower_party_id,
        inst2.institution_id
) loan_overdue
    ON ma.obligor_party_id = loan_overdue.borrower_party_id
    AND inst.institution_id = loan_overdue.institution_id
WHERE
    phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
GROUP BY
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    phs.holding_id,
    loan_overdue.total_overdue_principal
ORDER BY
    phs.lookthrough_depth DESC,
    phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT

    COUNT(*) AS valid_first_priority_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_ratio_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        cl.collateral_id,
        cl.pledge_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cl.collateral_id ORDER BY cl.lien_priority ASC) AS rn
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND cl.lien_priority IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE t.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.collateral_id
HAVING valid_first_priority_count >= 2
ORDER BY high_ratio_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,

SELECT

JOIN
    institution i ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id

SELECT

ORDER BY core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT

FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT

FROM
    institution i

    financial_snapshot fs ON i.institution_id = fs.subject_id

    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL

    i.institution_name,
    fs.annual_revenue
HAVING

SELECT

GROUP BY ma.valuation_method

SELECT

JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id

GROUP BY

ORDER BY

SELECT
    i.institution_name,

FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
    fs.net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets, 2) AS under_provision_ratio
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
  AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    fs.net_assets
HAVING SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY
    under_provision_ratio DESC,
    i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE
    cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND rc.classification_basis = '人工认定'
GROUP BY
    cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC,
    cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_id,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / fs.annual_revenue, 6) AS overdue_ratio
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
    INNER JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    INNER JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
    INNER JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    INNER JOIN institution inst ON ca.institution_id = inst.institution_id
    INNER JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || inst.institution_id
WHERE
    lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
    AND fs.annual_revenue > 0
GROUP BY
    inst.institution_id,
    fs.annual_revenue
HAVING
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / fs.annual_revenue, 6) > 0.5
ORDER BY
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS principal_balance_sum,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ld.status != 'SETTLED'
  AND ld.status != 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY loan_to_rwa_ratio DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    t1.payment_mode,
    COUNT(t1.instruction_id) AS instruction_count
FROM payment_instruction t1
INNER JOIN loan_drawdown t2
    ON t1.loan_id = t2.loan_id
WHERE
    t1.status = 'PENDING'
    AND t2.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    t1.payment_mode
HAVING
    COUNT(t1.instruction_id) > 45
ORDER BY
    instruction_count DESC,
    t1.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(r.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(r.amount_value), 2) AS abnormal_amount,
    fs.net_capital,
    fs.total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(r.amount_value) * 1.0 / fs.net_capital * 100, 4) AS ratio_to_net_capital_pct
FROM institution i
JOIN ai_system_record_v3 r ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON 'PTY-' || i.institution_id = fs.party_id
WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
  AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    fs.net_capital,
    fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(r.record_id) >= 8
ORDER BY ratio_to_net_capital_pct DESC;

WITH
-- 1. 计算各机构在审计基准日 '2026-06-30' 的拨备不足借据数与拨备缺口金额
provision_gap AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ps.loan_id) AS insufficient_provision_count,
        ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_amount
    FROM provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),

-- 2. 计算各机构在审计基准日 '2026-06-30' 的监管报送逾期记录数与台账平均金额
-- 假设 'REGULATORY_OVERDUE' 为监管报送事项中代表“已逾期未完成”的事件代码
-- 使用 regulatory_submission_event_v3 表，筛选 status_code 为 'ACTIVE' (有效/未完成) 且 event_code 关联逾期
regulatory_overdue AS (
    SELECT
        rse.institution_id,
        COUNT(rse.record_id) AS overdue_record_count,
        ROUND(AVG(rse.amount_value), 2) AS avg_overdue_amount
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse
    WHERE rse.event_date <= '2026-06-30'
      AND rse.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
      AND rse.event_code IN (
          SELECT event_code 
          FROM regulatory_event_catalog 
          WHERE event_name_zh LIKE '%逾期%' 
             OR event_code LIKE '%OVERDUE%'
      )
    GROUP BY rse.institution_id
)

-- 3. 关联机构信息并输出结果
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ro.overdue_record_count,
    ro.avg_overdue_amount,
    pg.insufficient_provision_count,
    pg.provision_gap_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN provision_gap pg ON i.institution_id = pg.institution_id
JOIN regulatory_overdue ro ON i.institution_id = ro.institution_id
WHERE ro.overdue_record_count >= 25
ORDER BY pg.provision_gap_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS facility_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gcv.exception_flag * gcv.amount_value), 2) AS abnormal_amount_sum,
    ROUND(AVG(gcv.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio_value
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 gcv ON i.institution_id = gcv.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(gcv.exception_flag) >= 5
ORDER BY abnormal_amount_sum DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_party_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_unrelated_relation_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE p.status = 'FROZEN'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY target_party_count DESC, relation_type_count DESC, p.display_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS cardholder_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS operational_risk_abnormal_amount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS operational_risk_active_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id IN (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.account_kind = 'CURRENT'
)
LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON ore.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE i.institution_id IN (
    SELECT institution_id
    FROM operational_risk_event_v3
    WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 43
)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY operational_risk_abnormal_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS on_sale_product_count,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_actual_raise_amount,
    COUNT(abrv.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(abrv.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio_value
FROM institution i
JOIN wealth_product wp
    ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
JOIN status_catalog sc
    ON wp.status = sc.status_code
    AND sc.entity = 'wealth_product'
    AND sc.name_zh = '在售'
LEFT JOIN ai_system_record_v3 abrv
    ON i.institution_id = abrv.institution_id
    AND abrv.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(abrv.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raise_amount DESC;

WITH asset_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ma.originator_institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
        ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount
    FROM managed_asset ma
    WHERE ma.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ma.originator_institution_id
),
custody_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        c.institution_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN c.status_code = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS active_record_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.exception_flag = 1 THEN c.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount_sum
    FROM custody_operation_event_v3 c
    GROUP BY c.institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN c.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 2
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    a.asset_count,
    a.total_issued_amount,
    c.active_record_count,
    c.abnormal_amount_sum
FROM custody_stats c
JOIN institution i ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN asset_stats a ON c.institution_id = a.originator_institution_id
ORDER BY a.total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
